title: Himeji tourism bureau — Otokoyama and castle viewpoints

facts.fact: The upper Otokoyama Haisuiike Park viewpoint overlooks the linked main and smaller castle keeps and requires a substantial staircase climb.
facts.excerpt: 男山の198段ある階段を登った山頂

facts.fact: The hillside also has Otokoyama Hachimangu and Senhime Tenmangu; the latter is associated with Senhime's prayers for the Honda household.
facts.excerpt: 本多家の繁栄を願って建立した

facts.fact: The tourism bureau explains the White Heron nickname by the castle's white-plaster appearance and identifies its National Treasure and World Heritage status.
facts.excerpt: 白漆喰で塗り込まれた優美な姿
